title: Agents stuck in a SAML login loop after the Okta migration
scenario: The morning after the IAM team recreated the Connect Okta app in a new Okta org, Monterrey agents bounce between Okta, AWS and a Connect sign-in page and never reach the workspace. AssumeRoleWithSAML succeeds in CloudTrail and the IAM team blames the CISO's Okta session-lifetime change.
task: Walk the IdP-initiated SAML flow hop by hop with the HAR, CloudTrail and both app exports
Fix only what is broken in the IdP configuration
Explain prevention: config as code, SSO canary
acceptance: Relay state uses the Connect federation format for the prod instance and Region; deep links URL-encoded
ACS URL, audience, Role/RoleSessionName attributes, trust policy, GetFederationToken scope and session duration stay valid
ANSWER.md explains why AssumeRoleWithSAML succeeds but no Connect session is created

practices.label: Week 9 - SAML 2.0 SSO for Connect: relay state, RoleSessionName, GetFederationToken
